verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents a facet search endpoint that is 'typically used to power auto-complete and type-ahead interfaces on top of filter menus', and its analytics tracks search queries. However, this autocompletes facet values only. Nothing in the evidence shows query suggestions derived from search traffic or a dedicated suggestions index, and one hands-on user said the only thing they miss is a typeahead feature. Missing for 10: query suggestions generated from real search traffic, a documented suggestions-index pattern or feature, analytics-to-suggestions integration, independent corroboration of autocomplete in practice.
